# Third-party components

| Folder | What | License |
|---|---|---|
| CodeWalker | `CodeWalker.Core.dll` built from the RAGE Tools fork of CodeWalker (dexyfex). Used to turn CodeWalker XML into .ydr / .ybn / .ytyp / .ymap. | CodeWalker: MIT (c) dexyfex. RAGE Tools: see LICENSE_RageTools.txt |
| szio | `Shaders.xml`: GTA V shader definitions (parameters, vertex layouts) from the Sollumz IO library `szio`. | MIT (c) Sollumz contributors, see LICENSE.txt |
| SharpDX | SharpDX 4.2.0 (needed by CodeWalker.Core). | MIT |
| ZstdSharp | `ZstdSharp.dll` 0.8.8 (ZstdSharp.Port, net8.0): pure C# Zstandard decoder, reads SPZ v4 Gaussian splat files. | MIT (c) Oleg Stepanischev |
